note: Named groups of cards. Membership is by slug; a card may sit in any number of sets. Loaded by Helpers.cards.load_card_set() as "sets".

sets.name: The Raid Pantheon
sets.description: The colossi at the end of Wynn's raids — the Wyrmling, Orphion and Anathema, the Colossus and the Anomaly.

sets.name: The Fruman Crown
sets.description: Her Majesty, Queen of Fruma, and the Sovereigns who rule her districts in her name.

sets.name: The Fruman Resistance
sets.description: Leaves in the Wind, The Canopy and The Steel Feather — the cells that push back against the Crown.

sets.name: Legends of the Provinces
sets.description: The names every adventurer learns long before Fruma: kings, heroes, villains and one very persistent Bob.

sets.name: Festival Spirits
sets.description: The faces of the Festival of the Spirits, the Heroes and the Bonfire.

sets.name: Dungeon Keepers
sets.description: The bosses waiting at the bottom of Wynn's dungeons.
